requirements.rule: SICKNESS COUNTING (Art. 66, CCNL 23 November 2023, p. 101): c. 1 keeps the job and the whole pay for 6, 8, 12, 15, 18 or 22 months of each illness by seniority (comporto_bands, 180 to 660 days); an employer that counts by c. 2 'con riferimento ai 48 mesi precedenti l'ultimo giorno di assenza considerato' (EmployerProfile.sickness_window_counting) has 8, 10, 14, 18, 22 or 24 months over that window (window_alternative, 240 to 720 days). The 50% extension (12 to 30 months) for tuberculosis requiring sanatorium admission or care, AIDS or severe disability, and the oncological double period (up to 36 months) apply when the episode states the qualifying diagnosis. Dialysis days must be stated to be excluded.
requirements.remediation: The last-period statutory minimum (c. 3), pension-eligible over-sixty ending (c. 8) and requested unpaid leave (c. 12) remain outside this calculation.

requirements.rule: OVERTIME, SATURDAY AND HOURLY BASE: Saturday overtime is paid 30% (Art. 114 c. 15), and the request has no Saturday kind. The hourly pay of overtime and of holiday work is 1/360 of the annual pay for each day divided by 7,4 (Art. 114 c. 15): the hourly divisor carries the 360 x 7,4 / 13, but the engine applies it to the minimo tabellare, and the elements of the 'retribuzione annua' (scatti and other fixed items) were not read.
requirements.remediation: Add a Saturday kind and read the elements of the annual pay that art. 114 c. 15 divides.

requirements.rule: APPRENTICESHIP (Art. 36, testo coordinato p. 53): the apprentice of a 3a area profile is placed one level below the destination for the first 18 months, then paid the destination level 'con assegno temporaneo, corrispondente, al netto'; at most 3 years. Every 3a area level is a destination: an apprentice to 3A1 starts at the Area unificata (1e2A). The assegno equals the destination in net terms; the engine pays the destination gross.
requirements.remediation: Model the assegno temporaneo as the gross that gives the destination-level net under the apprentice contribution rates, or open a limitation stating the overpayment.

requirements.rule: INPS RATES: the employer and worker INPS rates of the sector (credito) are totals no 2026 INPS or association table confirms: the only component split found is the INPS guide of 2012 and the 2026 totals come from a software house page that does not prove its year. The contributions of every run rest on them.
requirements.remediation: Source the credito rates of 2026 on an INPS or association table, mark the inps block of contribution/2026/credito.json derived, then remove this note.

requirements.rule: A parental leave by the hour takes half the average daily hours a day and counts two such days as one day of leave, the general criterion of art. 32 c. 1-ter D.Lgs. 151/2001 (INPS circ. 152/2015 par. 2.2); a collective agreement, also of the company, that sets other hours to a day of leave or other rules of cumulation prevails, and the bundle holds none.
requirements.remediation: Source the collective rules on the leave by the hour of the CCNL (hours of a day of leave, cumulation) and apply them, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: SCATTI: the freeze of 1 January 2013 - 31 July 2014 (Art. 103 c. 3, testo coordinato p. 142) is modelled (seniority_increments.freezes). The aree professionali in service on 19 December 1994 keep 'il numero massimo complessivo di 12 scatti' (Art. 103 c. 2, PDF p. 142, https://www.fabi.it/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/ccnl-23-nov-2023_fabi.pdf, sha256 4d92bc5226736682ddb1eedfaf7940df989fdc3cbbd99d0fa6347fd91979a933): seniority_increments.in_service_cohort, read from the stated employment period. The quadri direttivi in service on that day keep 'il numero degli scatti ivi stabilito' by the CCNL of 1994 (Art. 94 c. 2, PDF p. 131), which this text does not print: they keep the caps of the later hires.
requirements.remediation: Source the number of scatti of the quadri direttivi in service on 19 December 1994 (CCNL ABI 19 dicembre 1994).

requirements.rule: The CCNL tier and the comporto are counted on the days of one episode and the relapses it continues. A CCNL that sums the sickness of separate episodes over a window (a calendar year, the last three years) can reach a lower tier or the end of the comporto earlier than the engine shows. The run is affected when an earlier episode outside the relapse chain is recorded. A CCNL whose comporto the engine counts over the calendar year (Commercio Art. 186 and the others with comporto_calendar_year) is not affected.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.sickness.day.rules (CCNL tier of a sick day)
requirements.remediation: Add the cumulation window of each CCNL to its sickness rule, with the source, and count the tier and the comporto over it.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid none, its treatment not being sourced.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.

requirements.rule: The una tantum of a renewal is paid from the CCNL data with readings no text read settles in full: a month of service in the covered period counts with the days of the una tantum (15 when the text is silent), over the months of the period; the absences of a month do not reduce it, though a text may pay the months 'di effettiva prestazione'; a part time is paid in proportion to its hours; a run without the employment period is paid none; the share of the covered months of earlier years is taxed apart as arrears.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.una_tantum.rules.una_tantum_events; CCNL agenti immobiliari FIAIP 19 May 2025 art. 163 (pp. 97-98, sha256 560d16410d3e41dc0bfb00bfe2a40ef65f2cd900234aeaee92018ed9fa21ead5)
requirements.remediation: Source the counting of the months, the part time and the taxation of each una tantum from its agreement, then resolve this limitation.
